model_annotation: The bar chart displays the negative log probability for various medical specialties, with the data categorized under the label "Mistralv0.2-Base" and "Fine-tuned on:". The horizontal axis represents six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled "Negative log probability," ranges from -22 to -27. For each specialty, a group of bars is shown, with each bar corresponding to a different fine-tuning dataset: Cardio (light blue), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars are arranged in groups by specialty, with the color of each bar indicating the dataset it represents. The negative log probability values are consistently low across all specialties, with the lowest values (most negative) appearing in the "Cardio" group, particularly for the "Cardio" dataset (light blue bar), which extends below -27. The highest values (least negative) are observed in the "Pediatrics" group, with the "Pediatrics" dataset (dark brown bar) showing a value just above -25. The chart visually compares the performance of the Mistralv0.2-Base model, fine-tuned on different medical datasets, across various specialties.
